description: This source file defines the IDurableStateMachine interface, which specifies methods for persisting, applying, and managing state in a durable storage system within a distributed or fault-tolerant environment.

classes.name: IDurableStateMachine
classes.description: An interface for a durable, persistent state machine with methods for state management, recovery, and cloning.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the state machine, clearing volatile state and preparing it for recovery or new operation.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies a log entry or snapshot during recovery.

methods.name: OnRecoveryCompleted
methods.description: Notifies that all prior log entries and snapshots have been applied.

methods.name: AppendEntries
methods.description: Writes pending state changes to the log.

methods.name: AppendSnapshot
methods.description: Writes a snapshot of the state machine.

methods.name: OnWriteCompleted
methods.description: Notifies that all prior log entries and snapshots written have been persisted.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep, independent copy of the state machine instance.
